name: Strivec
definition: A neural scene representation that models a 3D scene as a radiance field using sparsely distributed and compactly factorized local tensor feature grids. It leverages tensor decomposition to model tensor grids, utilizing a cloud of local tensors and applying CP decomposition to factorize each tensor into triple vectors.
summary: Strivec is a neural scene representation using sparsely distributed, compactly factorized local tensor feature grids to efficiently model 3D radiance fields without empty space.
